title: LANCING OUT
INTO THE DEEP
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: ancient stone table in soft light

scenes.a: As you consider that task that has yielded you nothing, listen to the Master.
Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
Lord, where my own labor feels empty, move me to cast my nets by your direction.
Grant me the courage to obey your instruction, knowing your provision overflows my limits today.
